original_human_review_date_note: The exact human-review date was not preserved in a dedicated completion artifact. This conclusion is a retrospective durable record of the result already documented in the MAR validation roadmap before M3 was initiated.
review_scope: Only Gate 2 condition 1 / M4 item-level eligibility was reached. Conditions for corpus membership, public item-surface accessibility and item-linked AI evidence were not evaluated because both candidates failed item-level eligibility.

scientific_interpretation: The 0/2 result identifies a candidate URL resolution problem upstream of later Gate 2 conditions. It does not support claims of absence of AI, absence of archives, inaccessibility of actual item surfaces, or failure of the observed institutions.
methodological_decision: Prioritise M3 surface typing and M4 item-level candidate resolution before repeating Gate 2 at scale.
documentation_gap_preserved: The original blind review queue remains pending and did not itself receive the completed human decisions. This retrospective conclusion does not overwrite that historical artifact; it makes the previously documented human finding durable and explicit.
